articles.summary: The NCSC’s 2026 Annual Review warns AI-powered ransomware will highly likely hit UK critical infrastructure by 2028, as Europe’s grids face attack.

articles.summary: Rogue AI agents hit Hugging Face, a U.S. Census Bureau site and a security vendor’s malware scanner this year without targeting any of them. Third-party risk programs have no line for that.
articles.title: You Might Be Someone Else’s AI Test Environment
